title: Vesper Crossroads - The Signpost Tune
_note: Hub waystation anchor. The Vesper motif at its cosy home base: stated plainly and complete in bars 1-2 (G3->C4->D4 lift overshoots, E4->D4->C4 settles home). gbc 4-voice band. 108 BPM, 4/4, comfortable C major. 16-bar loop, tight and never-grating. harmony=light bell-ish pulse12 arps outlining I-vi-IV-V. bass=simple rooted walk bouncing on 1 and 3. drums=soft brushy hat + light kick. Last bar G dom -> resolves into C downbeat of bar 1.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: A: full Vesper statement, friendly. A': repeat with a small turn. B: gentle vi/IV lift. A'': home. Small range C4-A4.
